description: Express routers as AI builders generate them: a products router whose PUT and DELETE routes have no auth middleware and no session check, and a Clerk-backed notes API where GET/POST use requireAuth() but PUT and DELETE were left without it. app.use(clerkMiddleware()) only attaches auth state and lets anonymous requests through, so it does not protect the routes below it. A Passport app (the 0.6 tutorial's global app.use(passport.authenticate("session")), which only loads req.user and passes anonymous requests, plus an express-rate-limit authLimiter mounted with app.use) and an Auth0 express-openid-connect app (app.use(auth({ authRequired: false })), the quickstart setup, where routes still need requiresAuth()) leave their PUT / PATCH / DELETE routes just as open: none of those middlewares rejects an anonymous request. Anyone can overwrite or delete any record. VC127 must fire on all eight.
